title: Portraits
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 22 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: People, painted fast. The Rawblocks series opens with a run of portraits, most of them drawn between November 5 and 9, 2022: a man in a plaid shirt with a cigarette, a hunched man in a cap, a figure in a hooded cloak of polka dots, a man in a beanie and beard. They are painted in soft discs of color with a loose line drawn over them, and the line is what makes them people.

Each one wears something. A cap, a bandana, sunglasses, a fur coat, a hoodie. The clothes are often more worked than the face, and the face is a few strokes: two eyes, a red mouth, a cigarette. The grounds are flat and plain, grey, olive, blue, so the figure is all there is.

The room opens with three cartoon heads from the first night and closes with two painted figures from January 2023. Watch how the painting changes between them, from a round yellow head to a woman in yellow light with no face at all.

chapters.title: The First Night
chapters.opening: October 30 and 31, 2022. Three cartoon heads to begin: a round yellow head in pink glasses, a face in sunglasses in orange rays, and a red-haired head on legs.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #3
works.text: A round yellow head wearing pink glasses, with a small red mouth and one curl of hair, on a body in a blue coat holding out a black glove. The ground is teal with soft discs, and a row of yellow triangles stands on the head like a crown of spikes. It is the first Rawblocks work after the two masks of May, drawn October 30, 2022, and it is a cartoon: a circle for a head, a dot for a nose.
works.caption: A round yellow head in pink glasses on a blue-coated body, holding out a black glove, on teal.
works.reading: The glasses are a pink rectangle with two small eyes inside, drawn in black. The coat is blue with a few darker strokes and a row of buttons. Red marks stand at the left edge like fence posts. Recorded with 238 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #6
works.text: A face in dark sunglasses drawn in yellow and purple line over a ground of orange rays, its mouth open on a row of white teeth.
works.caption: A face in dark sunglasses in yellow and purple line over orange rays, mouth open on white teeth.
works.reading: The rays are painted in soft orange and yellow bands from the upper left. The sunglasses are two black lenses with grey highlights. The line of the face is drawn in thick yellow with purple beside it. Eighty-seven strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #7
works.text: A red-haired head on two black legs walks across orange, grinning with white fangs, one arm out, its hair a cloud of red scribble.
works.caption: On orange, a red-haired head with white fangs walks on two black legs, one arm held out.
works.reading: The hair is a mass of red and orange loops that fills the upper left. The face is yellow scribble with two small eyes and a mouth of white triangles. The legs are two black lines with feet. Fifty-five strokes.

chapters.title: One Evening in November
chapters.opening: November 5, 2022. Six portraits in two hours, from a man in plaid to a hunched man in a cap.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #8
works.text: A man with a red cap of hair and blue eyes stands in a plaid shirt, painted in grey, brown and teal with white line over it, a cigarette at his lips. The ground is brown with dark shapes at the right. The shirt is drawn as a grid of lines over dark paint, and the face is a few strokes: two blue eyes, a red mouth, a line for the nose. It is the first of the November portraits, drawn at 21:02 UTC.
works.caption: A man with red hair and blue eyes in a plaid shirt, a cigarette at his lips, on brown.
works.reading: The hair is painted in red and teal with white loops. The eyes are two small blue marks with dark lids. The plaid is drawn in white and grey lines over a dark shirt. Recorded with 123 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #9
works.text: A man in a blue striped shirt sits with his hands on his knees, his trousers black with white stripes, on a grey ground, his small face painted in brown.
works.caption: A man in a blue striped shirt sits with his hands on his knees, striped black trousers, on grey.
works.reading: The shirt is bright blue with white vertical lines and a few red marks. The face is brown with orange hair and two dark eyes. The room behind is grey bands with a lighter band at the top. Recorded with 106 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #10
works.text: A man in a camouflage shirt raises one arm against dark green, his hair blue, his mouth red, drawn in white line over painted tan and brown.
works.caption: A man in a camouflage shirt raises one arm against dark green, blue hair, a red mouth.
works.reading: The camouflage is painted in tan with brown and black blotches. The raised arm goes off the top edge. The hair is a patch of blue strokes, and the eyes are two dark rings. Recorded with 163 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #11
works.text: A figure in a hooded cloak of blue and white stripes with yellow polka dots, a brown face inside the hood drawn in orange scribble with one blue eye, on teal inside a loose white frame. The cloak is painted in soft blue with the stripes and dots drawn over it. The face is small and the cloak is huge, and the frame around the whole thing is drawn in a few white strokes, like a window.
works.caption: A figure in a hooded cloak of blue stripes and yellow polka dots, a brown face inside, on teal.
works.reading: The dots are yellow circles at even spacing along the stripes. The face is drawn in orange and black loops over brown, with one blue eye and a red mouth. The white frame is three or four lines around the edges. Recorded with 170 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #12
works.text: A hunched man in a dark cap looks down against purple, his face painted in gold and brown with a red eye, a band of pink light crossing behind him.
works.caption: A hunched man in a dark cap looks down against purple, a band of pink light behind him.
works.reading: The cap is a dark rounded shape with a brim. The face is modelled in gold and brown with a red patch at the eye. The band of light is a soft pink stripe behind the head. Recorded with 210 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #13
works.caption: A red-haired figure with crossed-out eyes in a huge white fur coat on orange, painted in soft discs.
works.reading: The coat is a mass of white and cream discs that fills the lower half. The face is brown with red hair and two X marks for eyes, drawn small. The orange ground is made of soft brown discs. Recorded with 202 strokes.

chapters.title: Glasses, Hoodies and Hats
chapters.opening: November 6 to 8, 2022. Eight portraits: glasses and curly hair, pink sunglasses, a cap and a cigarette, a bandana, a beanie and a beard.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #14
works.text: A man with curly hair and glasses in profile on olive, painted in grey and lilac, with red lips and a dark coat, the glasses drawn as a single lens.
works.caption: In profile on olive, a man with a cloud of curly hair, one grey lens for glasses, red lips.
works.reading: The hair is a cloud of black loops with pink and blue inside. The glasses are one grey lens with a dark frame and white highlights. The lips are red with a white line. Recorded with 332 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #15
works.text: A face drawn in black line with curly hair, lit by rainbow rays from behind, its eyes yellow and its mouth a grin of teeth.
works.caption: A face drawn in black line with curly hair, lit by rainbow rays from behind, yellow eyes, a grin.
works.reading: The rays are soft bands of blue, lilac, yellow and pink from the top. The hair is a loop of black line with scribble inside. The eyes are yellow with spiky lashes. Recorded with 184 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #16
works.text: A man in pink sunglasses and a blue hood, painted in brown and grey, his hair a crest of red and orange strokes, his mouth open on orange teeth with red drips falling from it. The sunglasses are one pink shape across the face with a dark lens. The hood is blue with white line. With 585 recorded strokes it is one of the most worked drawings in the room, and the drips are the one violent mark in a room of calm faces.
works.caption: A man in pink sunglasses and a blue hood, red hair, his mouth open on orange teeth with red drips.
works.reading: The hair is drawn in long red and orange strokes over black. The sunglasses are pink with a single dark lens and a white rim. The drips are three red lines from the mouth. The ground is olive.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #17
works.text: A man in a blue cap and sunglasses with a red beard smokes a cigarette, in profile on olive with a field of white dots behind him. The cap is drawn in blue with a dark brim, the sunglasses are black with a purple lens, and the beard is orange scribble. His jacket is red with white sleeves. The cigarette is drawn in white with a red tip. It is the room's most complete figure: hat, glasses, beard, jacket, cigarette, all in one.
works.caption: A man in a blue cap and sunglasses with a red beard smokes a cigarette, white dots behind him.
works.reading: The white dots are drawn at even spacing across the olive ground. The beard is orange and brown loops. The jacket is red with a white collar and sleeves drawn in soft strokes. Recorded with 518 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #18
works.text: A profile in a red bandana and glasses, with a gold earring drawn as a spiral, red lips, and a yellow jacket, on a ground of soft yellow and pink discs. The bandana is drawn in red scribble with a blue band across it. The face is painted in pink and lilac and drawn over in black. With 708 recorded strokes it is the most worked drawing in the room.
works.caption: A profile in a red bandana and glasses, a gold spiral earring, red lips, a yellow jacket, on soft discs.
works.reading: The earring is a yellow spiral hanging from the ear. The glasses are a black frame with a lilac lens. The jacket is yellow with a row of buttons drawn in yellow dots. The lips are red with white teeth.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #21
works.text: A painted head with green curly hair and a small red mouth on blue, its face grey and purple with two round eyes, a hand at the shoulder.
works.caption: Green curly hair over a grey and purple face with a small red mouth, on flat blue.
works.reading: The hair is green and yellow loops over the top of the head. The eyes are two rings, one yellow and one white, at different heights. The shoulders are painted in brown with green and pink strokes. Recorded with 201 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #22
works.text: The same head, half an hour later, with red goggles and a beam of gold pouring from its mouth to the right.
works.caption: A painted head with green hair and red goggles, a beam of gold pouring from its mouth.
works.reading: The goggles are two red lenses in a dark frame. The beam is a soft yellow wedge from the mouth to the right edge. The hair and the shoulders are the same as the head before. Recorded with 388 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #23
works.text: A man in a red beanie with a brown beard and blue eyes, in a yellow jacket, on blue. The face is painted in dark blue and brown with colored scribble over it, and the eyes are two rings under drawn lashes. The beanie is red with a folded brim. The jacket is yellow with a row of buttons. It is the last of the November portraits, drawn November 8, with 592 recorded strokes.
works.caption: A brown-bearded man in a red beanie and yellow jacket, blue eyes under drawn lashes, on blue.
works.reading: The beard is drawn in brown loops with orange over it. The eyes are two blue rings with yellow lashes. The jacket is painted in soft yellow with white and orange line. The ground is flat blue.

chapters.title: Cartoons and Two Painted Figures
chapters.opening: November 9, 2022, three cartoon heads with horns and goggles. Then, after ten weeks, two painted figures from January 23, 2023.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #26
works.text: A cartoon head on red with pink lashes, yellow eyes, pink cheeks, a mustache and a horn, two black hands raised at the sides.
works.caption: A cartoon head on red with pink lashes, yellow eyes, pink cheeks, a mustache and a horn, hands raised.
works.reading: The face is painted in brown and red with white highlights. The lashes are pink spikes above each eye. The mustache is a brown curve over a grin of white teeth. The hands are two black shapes at the lower corners. Recorded with 116 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #27
works.text: A dark cartoon head on purple with a crown of red dots and white spikes, orange lashes, and a beam of orange light crossing from the left, on a thin neck of bones.
works.caption: A dark cartoon head on purple crowned with red dots, orange lashes, a beam of orange light from the left.
works.reading: The crown is a row of red dots with white zigzag above. The eyes are two orange fans of lashes. The beam is a soft orange band across the face. The neck is drawn as a few white bones. Recorded with 163 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #28
works.text: A head with curly yellow hair, blue goggles, a red clown nose and white lips, on red, with green dots on the cheeks and a striped wand at the right.
works.caption: Curly yellow hair, blue goggles, a red clown nose and white lips, green dots on the cheeks, on red.
works.reading: The hair is a mass of yellow loops. The goggles are a blue frame with yellow eyes inside. The lips are white with a pink line. The wand at the right is a striped stick with a yellow tip. Recorded with 309 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #51
works.text: A woman with dark hair in yellow light, her face a cloud of pale discs with no features but a blue mark and a small red mouth, her hands drawn in black at the lower corners. Sixty-eight strokes. Ten weeks after the man in plaid, the painting has gone soft: the light is the subject, and the face is almost gone.
works.caption: A woman with dark hair in yellow light, her face a cloud of pale discs, a small red mouth.
works.reading: The hair is painted in black and grey strokes falling to the shoulders. The face is made of overlapping pale yellow discs with a small blue cross for the nose. The hands at the bottom are black outlines. The ground is flat yellow.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #52
works.text: A figure with purple hair looks up on black, its face painted in gold and green with scribble over it, one arm raised and the other reaching out, drawn in brown line.
works.caption: A figure with purple hair looks up on black, its face gold and green, one arm raised, one reaching out.
works.reading: The hair is a cloud of purple and lilac loops at the top. The face is painted in gold and green with red lips and two ringed eyes. The arms are drawn in thin brown line with white edges. Recorded with 224 strokes.

closing: Look again at the man in plaid with his cigarette, drawn in a few strokes on the first evening of November, and then at the woman in yellow light from January. Both are people. One is drawn in line over paint. The other is paint with almost no line, and the face has dissolved into the light.
